name: Orta Nova

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Puglia DOC in the province of Foggia for red and rosé wine based on Sangiovese. Uva di Troia, Montepulciano, Lambrusco Maestri and Trebbiano Toscano may make up to 40%, with Lambrusco Maestri and Trebbiano Toscano each capped at 10%.
